use_cases: Encourage free users to upgrade to paid subscription tiers
Display promotional upgrade messages on dashboard or settings pages
Drive conversion by highlighting premium features and benefits
Prompt users to unlock advanced capabilities with a dismissible call-to-action
ai_summary: A dismissible upgrade banner component with smooth framer-motion animations designed to drive user conversions from free to paid tiers. Features customizable button text, description, close handler, and click action props. Built for SaaS and subscription-based platforms requiring elegant upgrade prompts that can be dismissed while maintaining user engagement.
